description_en: Uninstalls software systems from an Enterprise High Performance Computing (E-HPC) cluster

kebab_example: aliyun ehpc uninstall-softwares --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --additional-packages Version=2024.1 Name=gromacs --api-version 2024-07-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UninstallSoftwares
